name: Tiger's Milk George
address: 23 Courtenay St, George Central, George, 6530, South Africa
description_short: Lively bar and grill in George Central serving gourmet burgers, craft beers, and creative cocktails.
description_long:
Tiger's Milk George brings the popular Cape Town brand's signature energy to the Garden Route. Located on Courtenay Street in the heart of George Central, this contemporary bar and grill offers a vibrant atmosphere perfect for after-work drinks or a casual night out with friends.

The menu showcases their famous gourmet burgers alongside wood-fired pizzas, sharing platters, and hearty mains. The bar is well-stocked with local craft beers and an impressive cocktail list that's become a Tiger's Milk trademark. Whether you're settling in for sundowners or catching live sports on the screens, the relaxed vibe makes it easy to linger.

With its central George location, it's a convenient spot for locals and visitors exploring the town. The modern industrial décor, friendly service, and crowd-pleasing menu have made it a popular choice for groups and casual dining in the area.
